we propose a novel method, SCSSP, for extraction of spatio-spectral discriminant features in MI- BCI systems, and we show that the proposed method competes closely, and sometimes even outperforms, the filter-bank CSP method.
the proposed method, SCSSP, can be considered as the spatio-spectrally extended version of the conventional spatial feature extractor, CSP.

the proposed SCSSPs can be easily computed for a large number of channels and frequency bands, which is not feasible with other existing feature extractors.
the SCSSP algorithm can be used as a general-purpose feature extractor in any MI-BCI system, regardless of the classification method used.
